title: Sheinbaum and Trump Talk. A Deal Appears Imminent
author: Redacción SinEmbargo
content:
_This article by the[Redacción of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/author/redaccion/) originally appeared
in the [September 17, 2026 edition of
SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4872340/sheinbaum-y-trump-habrian-
conversado-hoy-un-acuerdo-comercial-parece-inminente/), one of Mexico’s
leading independent digital news outlets._

**Mexico City, September 17 (SinEmbargo).** — Claudia Sheinbaum, President of
Mexico, and Donald Trump, leader of the United States (U.S.), spoke yesterday
about **a possible bilateral trade agreement** that, it is said, could be
signed in the coming weeks. Two sources confirmed as much to SinEmbargo,
though they said they were not authorized to reveal it. At least two
international outlets also affirm it.

According to information revealed by Politico and Bloomberg, both U.S.
outlets, the Mexican president and her counterpart from the neighboring
country held a telephone conversation on Wednesday, in which they addressed
the issue of binational trade.

A U.S. official, cited by Politico, described the talk between Sheinbaum and
Trump as “constructive,” and asserted that the conversations between Mexico
and the U.S. are advancing in a positive direction; the official also noted
that any idea that the call did not go well is “mistaken.”

According to statements from a person familiar with the situation, mentioned
by the same outlet, the call between Sheinbaum and Trump led Mexican officials
to believe that the two could reach an arrangement to resolve the differences
related to the Mexico–United States–Canada Agreement (USMCA).

The dialogue between President Sheinbaum and President Trump comes just days
before the meeting between the negotiating teams of Mexico and the United
States to continue the review of the USMCA, **scheduled to take place on
September 28 and 29 in Washington**.

On Wednesday, President Donald Trump said that his administration is close to
closing “a great deal” on trade with Mexico, this amid the negotiations
between the two countries related to the USMCA.

![Donald Trump at an event](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/09/2026-09-17-sheinbaum-trump-deal-02-trump.jpg)Donald
Trump. Photo: via SinEmbargo

Days earlier, the U.S. leader denied that the United States would withdraw
from the trade agreement signed by the countries of North America and revealed
his intention to reach an arrangement with the Mexican government **before the
midterm elections, which will be held this coming November 3**.

When asked about Trump’s proposal, the Mexican Secretary of the Economy,
Marcelo Ebrard, declined to confirm whether this will be possible, arguing
that “it depends on many things.”

Faced with questions from the press, the head of the Secretariat of the
Economy (SE) stressed that the possibility of reaching a trade agreement
before the November elections in the U.S. is a proposal made by the U.S.
president, although he did not confirm whether Mexico is willing to reach an
arrangement.
